TE-09 (spec v5 §17): clearing the engine memo table changes no returned value — memoisation is an implementation detail, never a semantic one
TE-05/TE-06 (spec v5 §17): annual savings === Σ monthly grossSavings and adoptionEndPct === last-month ramp, by construction
TE-07 (spec v5 §17): exactly one payback definition — canonical accessor === first cumulative crossing, and the registry/ROI read it (scenario-local payback excluded by design)
TE-08 (spec v5 §17): exactly one case-NPV definition — registry npv8 === canonical monthly-discounted engine NPV at the live case discount rate (flowValue revenue-NPV is a distinct metric, excluded)
CC-DEP-01 (DEPS-SPEC v2.0): every dependency edge points at a live catalogue section — no ghost nodes

CC-DEP-02 (DEPS-SPEC v2.0, advisory): every section tagged `drives` actually drives something. The reverse assertion (many outgoing edges ⇒ must be tagged drives) was withdrawn in v18.8 — relay surfaces legitimately carry outgoing edges while owning no inputs
TE-11 (spec v5 §17, supersedes CC-MP-02): Monthly Playback FTE, vFTE and ramp all derive from the one live engine rampAt(t) — the workforce curve and the cost curve can no longer disagree

TE-06b (spec v5 §16.2): Monte Carlo thin mode reproduces the full engine (NPV, payback, per-year savings/run) to float tolerance — the kernel is byte-identical, so the MC P50 matches the deterministic method
TE-12 (spec v5 §17): materialise() carries the same headline and inputHash as a fresh engine on the same inputs — the stored package round-trips, so load-time staleness detection is trustworthy

TE-14 (spec v5 §17): every named projection (curve/automation/workforce/financial/maturity/annual/timeline) is reproducible from the one engine — the v3 series vocabulary survives as read-only views, not stored sources of truth
TE-CURVE (spec v5 §5): every registered real curve (logistic/gompertz/bass) produces a monotone, normalised 0..ceiling adoption series on the live anchors — adapter conformance
TE-HZN (Horizon-Dynamic spec §10): engine.years() spans horizonYears and the end-year KPIs (netSavY3/runCostY3) equal engine.year(horizonYears) — no fixed "Y3" leaks when the horizon is not 3
CC-OV-01 (v18.9): the Time Engine overlay applied to model() without error — Annual / Run / Results / Excel figures agree with Financial and Monthly, which read the engine directly
TE-DEP (spec v5 §10.3): the Time Engine is registered as the first live DEP node and TIME.current tracks the current inputs with the active curve — the dependency graph drives engine invalidation
